en: The postcard shows a crowded seaside bath complex with a wide beach, a pier filled with bathers in swimsuits, and a large building in the background. There are trees and several buildings visible in the distance. The text on the postcard is printed in both Cyrillic and French, indicating its likely Eastern European origin and appeal to both local and French-speaking audiences.
